description: Set a reminder that surfaces automatically at the start of your next session. Use for follow-ups, things to check, or deferred work. Reminders auto-archive after being shown.

content.description: What to remind about (e.g., "Check if PR #42 was merged")

ttl.description: How long to keep the reminder alive. Format: "24h", "7d", "30d". Default: 7 days.

name: set_reminder
